correctness.rationale: Normalize ess inf on the root interval to zero and BLO seminorm <=1. In the dyadic child split write a=(a0+a1+d)/2 and d between child minima. The affine Bellman candidate B_lambda(a)=1+Ca with C=(e^lambda−1)/(2−e^lambda) is a supermartingale: for d≤1 use convexity e^{lambda d}−1≤(e^lambda−1)d; for 1≤d≤2 use a1≤2−d and e^{lambda(d−1)}(1−(e^lambda−1)(d−1))≤1. Martingale approximations and Fatou transfer the bound to arbitrary integrable BLO functions. Geometric dyadic staircases have BLO=1 and root excess a, achieving the envelope for each a and diverging at lambda≥log 2. Independently checked all child-inequality boundary regimes numerically as diagnostics only; analytic inequalities supply proof.
